target: forge.sh pr-state — /pull/ URLs on github.com and on a configured GitHub Enterprise host (FORGE=github, remote on that host) go through gh, whatever the repo's kind elsewhere; gh failures are UNKNOWN
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
export FORGE=gitlab FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
fx_gh pr_view 0 MERGED
fx_run pr-state https://github.com/o/r/pull/3; echo "https://github.com/o/r/pull/3->$FX_OUT"
fx_setremote https://ghe.example.test/o/r.git
export FORGE=github
fx_run pr-state https://ghe.example.test/o/r/pull/12; echo "https://ghe.example.test/o/r/pull/12->$FX_OUT"
echo "gh_views=$(fx_count gh pr view)"; echo "requests=$(fx_nreq)"
fx_calls_text
gs() { fx_gh pr_view 0 "$2"; fx_run pr-state https://github.com/o/r/pull/3; echo "g_$1=$FX_OUT"; }
gs OPEN OPEN; gs CLOSED CLOSED; gs garbage REOPENED
fx_gh pr_view 1 ''; fx_run pr-state https://github.com/o/r/pull/3; echo "g_fail=$FX_OUT rc=$FX_RC"
fx_done
